item.title: Kalen DeBoer delivers Alabama football another top five recruiting class
item.description: In his second full recruiting cycle, Alabama football head coach Kalen DeBoer signed another top five recruiting class.In consecutive seasons, DeBoer has pulled in the No. 4 recruiting class, according to 247 Sports, with 20 signees for the 2026 class.
